title: SF1402 (2023-2024 Regular): Visitor carrying of firearms regulation on campuses of public postsecondary institutions

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-02-07; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/SF/1402/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced text. Struck text left out of quotes. Version read: introduced text (as filed). No passage vote is recorded for this bill.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 18): A public postsecondary institution regulated under chapter 136F or 137 may establish policies that restrict the carry or possession of firearms by visitors while on the institution's property. A person carrying a firearm in violation of the public postsecondary institution policies may be ordered to leave the premises. A person who fails to leave when so requested is guilty of a petty misdemeanor.
